title: Lemon Studio Michael Lane Edition 2026.11.03.1 — Wave, MPE and Intel Mac
notes:
Complete Lemon Studio DAW release for Windows, Linux x64, Apple-silicon Mac and Intel Mac. Includes built-in Lemon Wave, organized factory instruments and effects, per-note MPE, independent clip effects, instrument layers, browser and tempo improvements, and the integrated Master Assistant.

Matching source archives and SHA256SUMS are included. [Full changelog and downloads](https://michaellanemusic.de/lemon-studio/).

Mac requires macOS 12 or newer; packages are ad-hoc signed, not notarized. Intel build and focused instrument/MPE/mastering checks passed under Rosetta, not physical Intel hardware. Linux was compiled and packaged; Linux runtime/audio testing was not performed. Physical MPE controllers and every third-party patch remain untested. Known ARA limitations remain.

Build source: bc6aba779a52d98dd8f17ac9a48e2e26f874dfb6. Later concurrent Lemon Wave envelope/filter development is outside this release.
